text:
```yaml
name: Coverage

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .[dev,examples]
    - name: Run tests with coverage
      run: |
        python -m pytest --cov=wove --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
        files: ./coverage.xml
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella
    - name: Generate coverage badge
      run: |
        pip install coverage
        coverage report --format=markdown > coverage_report.md
        echo "![Coverage](coverage_badge.svg)" >> README.md
    - name: Commit coverage badge
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
      with:
        commit_message: "docs: update coverage badge"
        file_pattern: coverage_badge.svg
        commit_user_name: github-actions[bot]
        commit_user_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
```
